description: Where a waiting caller stands in their queue

Agents-Available.description: How many agents could be offered a caller right now; absent when the dispatcher cannot say, which is not zero

Joined-Timestamp.description: When the caller entered the queue, in Gregorian seconds

Media-Node.description: The media server the caller's channel is parked on

Offered.description: Whether an offer is in flight for the caller: asked for or ringing, and neither answered nor called off

Position.description: The caller's place in the queue, counting from one

Queue-ID.description: Queue the caller is waiting in

Timestamp.description: When this was true, in Gregorian seconds

Waiting.description: How many callers are waiting in the queue
